sorun: Readable text on clothes and signs
ek: All uniforms, signs and clothes are plain with no readable text or letters.
Nobody ever looks into the camera.

sorun: Comic sound effects and music that nobody asked for
ek: Realistic sound only: no comic sound effects, no cartoon sounds, no laugh track, no music.

sorun: The character looks at the lens
ek: The character never looks at the camera and never makes eye contact with the lens; the eyes stay only on what is in front of the character.

sorun: A spoken line is repeated or mouthed again
ek: Every line is said only once. After the last word the lips stay closed and still to the last frame; nobody repeats or mouths any word.

sorun: Pimples and spots on the skin
ek: Every person has smooth, clear skin with no pimples, no spots and no blemishes.
